detailed_description:
Photorealistic real-actor movie cinematography, one uninterrupted shot. Begin with Carlos already back-facing or side-facing inside the same dense formation as the preceding segment. Reproduce the source lead's 00:10-00:20 movement and camera progression frame by frame, including the lateral passage through the ranks, turns, visibility changes and final position. Carlos is the only person in the formation who performs the lead's arm and body actions.
The white-suited people are a dense, quiet, stationary formation. Every person stands upright with both arms hanging straight down beside the body, hands resting beside the thighs, elbows pointing downward, shoulders relaxed. This exact arms-down posture remains unchanged for the entire shot while the camera and Carlos move through the formation. Keep their bodies separate, evenly spaced according to the source, and at stable adult scale. The frame remains filled by the white-suited formation.
Use no separate location view, no studio background, no character-sheet panels, no titles, subtitles or watermarks. No new action is added to the formation. End on the source 00:20 composition and pose.
